page_title: ACM 2-0 MON | AC Milan v Monza 24/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
89' Andrea Petagna (Monza) is caught offside!
88' Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
88' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
88' Corner kick. Monza will have an opportunity.
86' Here comes a substitution. Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is brought on as a substitute for Christian Pulisic.
86' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
83' Alessandro Nesta has decided to substitute Semuel Pizzignacco and he is replaced by Andrea Mazza (Monza).

82' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Armando Izzo (Monza) replaces Luca Caldirola.
80' Here comes a substitution. Joao Felix is given a rest as he is replaced by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan).
79' Alessandro Nesta has decided to make a change. Andrea Petagna (Monza) replaces Keita Balde.
77' Poor challenge! Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) is penalised for tripping and Daniele Rutella blows his whistle. AC Milan are awarded the free kick.
76' Monza are ruled offside.
74' 2 - 0 Joao Felix (AC Milan) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight into the top left corner. A technically perfect strike!

73' Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. AC Milan are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
72' Stefano Sensi (Monza) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
72' Monza quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
71' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Monza have a corner.
70' Alessandro Nesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) replacing Gianluca Caprari.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Patrick Ciurria will be replaced by Stefano Sensi (Monza).

67' CHANCE! Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
64' 1 - 0 The corner from Samuel Chukwueze goes into a dangerous area and finds Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan), who outjumps the defence and glances a header into the back of the net. 1:0.
64' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) prepares to take a corner kick.
64' Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
63' Joao Felix (AC Milan) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
62' AC Milan concede a free kick following a bad challenge. There is a free kick near the sideline to Monza.
62' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Semuel Pizzignacco.
61' Joao Costa decides to make a substitution. Davide Bartesaghi will be replaced by Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan).
57' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
57' Keita Balde (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
56' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
56' Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) commits a foul and Daniele Rutella immediately signals a free kick. Monza win a free kick.
56' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

52' Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
51' The foul by Alessandro Bianco (Monza) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniele Rutella.

50' Close! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.

49' Joao Felix (AC Milan) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Semuel Pizzignacco has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
49' Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

47' Close! Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

47' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
46' The substitution is prepared. Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luka Jovic.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Joao Costa probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Yunus Musah (AC Milan). He is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze.
46' Referee Daniele Rutella blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
44' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Keita Balde (Monza) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

43' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
42' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Keita Balde (Monza) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee blows his whistle, Monza are awarded a corner kick.

40' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Joao Felix (AC Milan), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.

38' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
38' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
36' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Monza will take a free kick.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.

35' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
35' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
34' AC Milan are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
33' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
32' Daniele Rutella blows his whistle after Andrea Carboni (Monza) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. AC Milan are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
30' A player from Monza commits a rough challenge. Daniele Rutella blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. AC Milan have been awarded a free kick.

25' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
22' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

21' The ball rebounds out to Yunus Musah (AC Milan) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
21' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
20' AC Milan are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
19' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and AC Milan will have a corner.
18' Flag goes up against Keita Balde (Monza) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
14' The foul by Yunus Musah (AC Milan) was seen by Daniele Rutella who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick to Monza.
14' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Semuel Pizzignacco punches the ball away.
13' Wasted opportunity. Alessandro Bianco (Monza) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
13' AC Milan fail to score from a corner as Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza) leaps to collect the ball.
13' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play and Monza manage to earn a corner.
11' Monza win a corner.

10' Pedro Pereira (Monza) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. It will be a corner kick for Monza.
8' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
8' Keita Balde (Monza) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
7' Daniele Rutella interrupts the game. One of the players from AC Milan won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick is awarded to Monza.
6' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but Semuel Pizzignacco dives superbly to deny him. His shot went towards the right side of the goal.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to AC Milan, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
3' AC Milan keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
2' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Monza was in an offside position.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Monza will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Rutella.
